semiconductor_relevance: Medium — while MEL Systems and Services Limited provides automation and testing solutions relevant to electronics manufacturing, it does not primarily focus on semiconductor-specific products or services.
summary: MEL Systems and Services Ltd. (MELSS) is an engineering and technology solutions provider with over 30 years of experience, specializing in automation and testing solutions for the electronics industry. They deliver turnkey automation projects and custom functional testing ATEs, which can support semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.India: MELSS is headquartered in Chennai and has a strong nationwide presence through sales and support offices across major metros.
